text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I-I did it... I...
I beat Sei-chan...!!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Aah. Looks like I'll have to show off
a side of me that isn't really 'me' for a while.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I can't afford to worry
about keeping up appearances anymore.”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Because next time, it'll be my turn to show you my back.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei-chan... The look on her face was completely different from anything before...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Just because we won once,
we can't go getting ahead of ourselves, can we?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure to level ourselves up
for the Tenno Sho (Spring) too...!
